Island Routes — Montego Bay fishing ↗
SEASON

When this trip makes sense.

A reliable month-by-month fishing window has not been established from the inspected material for this particular trip. Ask the local operator or fisheries service to confirm the target, access and conditions for your dates before making non-refundable arrangements.

The decision that shapes this trip

Confirm the charter’s operating details rather than assuming a resort activity includes the boat. Ask how many guests will fish, what equipment is supplied and whether transfers are part of the offer before building your schedule.

Build around a confirmed boat plan

Ask the crew to identify the primary target and method, the actual time spent fishing and how anglers share the available positions. Confirm the tackle that is supplied before buying rods or terminal gear. Keep spare clothing and electronics protected from spray.

LICENCE & PERMITS

Fishing licence for Jamaica

Jamaica requires fishers and their vessels to register, including recreational fishers. Do not assume a charter booking removes the licence requirement; confirm your visitor documents with the authority.

Official rules ↗

Rules for this water

  • Do not fish inside the Bogue Island Lagoon special fishery conservation area.
  • Check the conservation-area boundaries before fishing around Montego Bay official regulations ↗
